children.value: Download errors are version-level outcomes, whereas the overall success rate is publication-level. Several errors may belong to one publication. PDF-only and no-TeX versions count as completed download attempts but do not provide parsable TeX. A missing Semantic Scholar record is an explicit completed lookup,
a paper with verified reference coverage. The 100% reference-metadata score applies only to saved arXiv-linked references and does not establish completeness of all bibliographies.

The saved average number of references is larger than the saved arXiv-linked subset. The current crawler can retain non-arXiv references too; the equality of saved-reference and arXiv-reference averages in this snapshot must not be interpreted as proof that every returned reference was retained.

- A paper has on average **{ru.num(D.get('avg_refs_per_paper'))}** references, **{ru.num(D.get('avg_arxiv_refs_per_paper'))}** of which carry an arXiv ID;
  the metadata of **{ru.pct(D.get('ref_metadata_success_rate_overall'))}** of those references is complete.
- The recorded resumed run took **{ru.duration(T.get('wall_seconds'))}**; peak RAM: **{ru.quantity(ru.mb(M.get('peak_bytes')), 'MiB')}**,

"""))

text/markdown.content:
- **5,000** papers with **6,101** versions were discovered in the assigned range;
  **4,978** of them were scraped successfully (**99.56%**).
- Removing figure binaries reduced the average paper size from **4.40 MiB**
  to **0.38 MiB**.
- A paper has on average **32.38** references, **15.41** of which carry an arXiv ID;
  the metadata of **100.00%** of those references is complete.
- The recorded resumed run took **0m 12s (12.2 s)**; peak RAM: **Not measured**,
  and the final corpus takes **1,822.37 MiB** on disk.
